component.name: Outpost
component.summary: Self-hosted chat with voice, for one community

description.p: Outpost is a self-hosted chat app: text channels, voice channels and direct messages for a single community, running on a server that community controls rather than on someone else's platform.
This is the desktop client. It connects to any Outpost server — your own, or one you've been invited to — and you can be signed into several at once.

ul.li: Text channels with replies, threads, reactions, custom emoji, code blocks, image and video attachments, and link previews
Voice channels with push-to-talk, automatic voice sensitivity, and screen sharing
Direct messages, with optional end-to-end encryption
Roles and permissions, moderation tools, and per-channel permission overrides
Two-factor authentication with TOTP or a security key

description.p: Running a server is a single Docker Compose file. Nothing in the app reports to a central service — there is no central service.

screenshot.caption: A text channel with replies and reactions
A voice channel with several people connected
Direct messages, with end-to-end encryption available
Roles and permissions in server settings

description.p: Turning encrypted direct messages on now applies straight away instead of needing a restart, and can be switched off again without losing your existing key or history.
Sign in with your own OpenID Connect provider. Camera video in voice channels. Noise suppression, echo cancellation and automatic gain can now be turned off individually.
End-to-end encrypted direct messages, with reporting and blocking to go with them. Screen sharing in the desktop app is fixed; it had never worked on any platform.
